memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent with ADLs, uses a walking stick for outdoor walks, reports mild dizziness on turning in bed.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (negative), no need for further assessment at present.
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months, gait steady with stick, timed up-and-go 11 seconds (within normal range).
medicines: 5 regular (betahistine 16 mg BD, levocetirizine 5 mg OD, cetirizine 10 mg HS, allopurinol 100 mg OD, febuxostat 40 mg OD) – polypharmacy, please review against Beers criteria.
mood: reports occasional frustration with vertigo episodes, denies depression.
carers: Lakshmi (wife).
goals: "I want to stay steady on my feet and continue helping at the pharmacy."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
betahistine 16 mg twice daily
meclizine 25 mg as needed for vertigo
levocetirizine 5 mg once daily
cetirizine 10 mg at bedtime
allopurinol 100 mg once daily
febuxostat 40 mg once daily
colchicine 0.5 mg twice daily during gout flares only

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: Hb 13.2 g/dL (12-16), WBC 6.8 x10^9/L (4-10), eosinophils 0.3 x10^9/L (0.0-0.5).
Thyroid: TSH 2.1 mIU/L (0.4-4.0), FT4 1.2 ng/dL (0.9-1.7).
Serum uric acid: 6.8 mg/dL (3.5-7.2).
Serum creatinine: 1.0 mg/dL (0.6-1.2).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: manages pharmacy counter with occasional assistance, reports less frequent vertigo spells.
cognition: no change, Mini-Cog not repeated yet.
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months, gait smooth with stick, timed up-and-go 10 seconds.
medicines: 5 regular (same as before) – polypharmacy, continue current regimen, consider tapering cetirizine if drowsiness.
mood: cheerful, enjoys interacting with customers.
carers: Lakshmi (wife).
goals: "I wish to keep working part‑time without dizzy episodes."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
betahistine 16 mg twice daily
meclizine 25 mg as needed
levocetirizine 5 mg once daily
cetirizine 10 mg at bedtime – try reducing to 5 mg if daytime sedation
allopurinol 100 mg once daily
febuxostat 40 mg once daily
colchicine 0.5 mg twice daily during flares only

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Audiometry: bilateral mild high‑frequency hearing loss, thresholds 30‑35 dB at 4‑8 kHz, compatible with age‑related changes; no conductive component.
Dix‑Hallpike: positive on right side, torsional nystagmus lasting <10 sec – confirms benign positional vertigo.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
betahistine 16 mg twice daily
meclizine 25 mg as needed – increase to two doses if vertigo persists
levocetirizine 5 mg once daily
cetirizine 5 mg at bedtime (reduced)
allopurinol 100 mg once daily
febuxostat 40 mg once daily
colchicine 0.5 mg twice daily during flares only

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: still independent, uses stick only for long walks, reports occasional mild light‑headedness after standing.
cognition: Mini‑Cog not due yet.
falls: 1 fall in last 12 months (slipped on wet floor at home, no injury), gait slightly unsteady, timed up‑and‑go 13 seconds – raised fall risk; advise home safety, strength exercises, and supportive footwear.
medicines: 5 regular (betahistine, levocetirizine, cetirizine, allopurinol, febuxostat) – polypharmacy, continue, discuss vitamin D supplementation.
mood: reports frustration after fall, denies depression.
carers: Lakshmi (wife).
goals: "I want to avoid another fall and stay safe at home."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum uric acid: 7.2 mg/dL (3.5-7.2) – at upper limit.
Serum creatinine: 1.1 mg/dL (0.6-1.2) – mild rise.
CBC: eosinophils 0.4 x10^9/L (normal).
Thyroid: TSH 2.0 mIU/L, FT4 1.1 ng/dL (normal).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports painful swelling of left big toe for 2 days, difficulty wearing shoe, otherwise ADLs independent.
cognition: unchanged.
falls: 0 new falls, gait antalgic on left side, timed up‑and‑go 14 seconds – raised fall risk; advise rest, ice, and continue exercises.
medicines: 5 regular plus colchicine during flare – polypharmacy, consider lowering febuxostat if tolerated.
mood: irritable due to pain, denies low mood.
carers: Lakshmi (wife).
goals: "I need the gout pain to settle so I can walk comfortably."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
betahistine 16 mg twice daily
meclizine 25 mg as needed
levocetirizine 5 mg once daily
cetirizine 5 mg at bedtime
allopurinol 100 mg once daily
febuxostat 40 mg once daily – continue
colchicine 0.5 mg twice daily for 3 days then once daily for 4 days (flare course)

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: back to baseline, toe pain resolved, uses stick for outdoor walks only.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 3/5 (negative) – no further assessment needed.
falls: 0 falls in past 12 months, gait steady with stick, timed up‑and‑go 11 seconds.
medicines: 5 regular (betahistine, levocetirizine, cetirizine, allopurinol, febuxostat) – polypharmacy, continue, review need for cetirizine.
mood: content, enjoys gardening.
carers: Lakshmi (wife).
goals: "I want to stay active and keep helping at the pharmacy."
